decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks are a low-cost consumable that fits the firm's thermoforming range, and they had a dedicated page in both observed years, so keeping the option open costs little and nothing signals failure.
The PETG thermoforming blank is a core material in the dental lab workflow with steady presence and minimal carrying cost, so dropping it would forgo value for no gain.
The UV-curing lacquer is only mentioned rather than featured, which suggests modest importance, but as a cheap complementary consumable it is still worth holding while demand settles.

Custom hearing protection earmolds fit the firm's custom-molding skills and remained listed even after the related earmold line was pruned, so the option still has value at low cost, although its weaker visibility carries some risk.
